bank.title: No bank password
bank.text: You enter your transactions in OrganizeUp itself. We don’t ask for your bank password or access to your account.

connection.title: Protected connection
connection.text: Access happens over a secure connection (HTTPS), and your OrganizeUp password is never stored in plain text: it’s protected by a hash.

control.title: You’re in control
control.text: OrganizeUp organizes and explains. It doesn’t move money and doesn’t suggest buying or selling investments.

bank.q: Do I need to connect my bank account?
bank.a: No. You record what comes in and goes out in OrganizeUp itself, without giving your bank password or access.

who.a: Inside the system, only the people in your family’s space see this data. Each family is kept separate from the others.

invest.a: No. It helps you organize and understand your plan. Investment decisions remain yours.

mobile.q: Does it work on my phone?
mobile.a: Yes. The system was designed for the phone screen first and works right in the browser, with nothing to install.
